title: Annex to the ADAS Sensor Calibrations Precheck Standard: Requirements Matrix by Tier
content:
This annex lists, for each ADAS Sensor Calibrations tier, which manufacturer preconditions apply to the vehicle before the calibration, the minimum fuel (or charge) level, and how long an in-spec alignment check remains valid for a precheck.

## Requirements matrix

| Requirement | Dynamic Camera Calibration | Static Camera Calibration | Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | Blind Spot Radar Calibration | Front Radar Calibration | Multi-System Calibration |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Four-wheel alignment check within specification required before the calibration | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Calendar days an in-spec alignment check remains valid for a precheck | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Minimum fuel (or charge) level for the procedure, percent of tank | 25 | 100 | 100 | 25 | 100 | 100 |
| Tires set to placard pressure before the procedure | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Vehicle must be empty of cargo | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Every diagnostic trouble code resolved before the precheck passes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Pre-calibration diagnostic scan run | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Sensor bracket and mounting inspected for damage before the precheck passes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Manufacturer's procedure document attached to the order before the precheck | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| A retry after a failed attempt repeats the alignment check | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |

## Notes

1. Blind Spot Radar Calibration is the only tier on which a four-wheel alignment check within specification is not required before the calibration.
2. The alignment check validity figure is 30 calendar days on every tier.
3. The fuel minimum is 25 percent of tank on Dynamic Camera Calibration and Blind Spot Radar Calibration and a full tank (100 percent) on the other four tiers.
4. Dynamic Camera Calibration is the only tier that does not require the vehicle to be empty of cargo.
5. Only Front Radar Calibration and Multi-System Calibration repeat the alignment check on a retry after a failed attempt.
